dct_description_sm:
This dataset maps the geographic boundaries that define ambulance service coverage areas across 
Prince Edward Island. These zones identify which ambulance provider is responsible for emergency 
medical response within each region. The dataset supports dispatch operations, emergency planning, 
and analysis of service accessibility and response coverage.

Each row represents a single Ambulance Coverage Zone polygon and its associated attributes.
